checkpoint_review: The Router's checkpoint verdicts are largely accurate regarding the physical structure of the jug. However, the Router was slightly lenient on the 'Material_and_Context' checkpoint regarding 'embossed lettering or decorative banding'. While it noted the text is illegible, it marked the checkpoint as 'present' because decoration exists. Strictly speaking, AI-generated gibberish is a failure to render the intended semantic content of 'lettering', even if the visual pattern of decoration is there. I agree with the 'is_present: true' for the general shape/material, but flag the text quality as a defect in the artifact review.

No new structural artifacts were found by experts that the Router missed.
